subject: PO remit split, multi-entity PO handling, and early-invoice trigger - NorthWind Health
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@northwind-health.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: PO remit addresses + invoice cadence question

Hi Vanessa,

Quick procurement question as we're preparing purchase orders for Redwood: our finance team will want to issue POs that capture two remit addresses (NorthWind Health - US entity, and NorthWind Health - UK branch) under one engagement. Can Redwood accept a single consolidated invoice that references multiple PO numbers, or do you require one invoice per PO?

Also: we have mixed expectations on net terms across entities (US prefers Net 30; UK prefers monthly statement net 45). Is there flexibility for your billing engine to: 1) map different net terms per PO/entity and 2) trigger an early invoice if we provide an advance/prepayment?

I've attached our standard PO template for reference. If easier, we can schedule a short call to walk through the options — finance wants to avoid stitching multiple vendor invoices into our ERP.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Director, Strategic Sourcing
NorthWind Health
Attachment: NorthWind_PO_Template.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@northwind-health.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO remit addresses + invoice cadence question

Hi Elaine — thanks for the note and the PO template. Happy to take this on. High-level options we can support today: 

- Consolidated invoice referencing multiple PO IDs: we can include multiple PO numbers in the invoice PDF and in the invoice metadata, but our AP system issues one PDF per invoice id (we can consolidate line items from multiple POs into a single invoice document if you include a clear mapping).

- Per-PO invoice (one invoice per PO): straightforward, recommended if each entity needs a distinct net term enforced by your ERP.

- Remit split: we can map remit addresses using AP distribution codes or BU codes in invoice headers. This lets you route accounting across entities without generating separate invoices for each remit address.

- Early invoice / advance: we can issue an advance/early invoice if there is a prepayment or committed credit. We typically require the prepay to be reflected as an advance on the invoice trail.

To avoid surprises, I'd like to loop in Ben from Finance (billing constraints) and Grace from Customer Success (contract/SOW implications). Ben/Grace — can you confirm: 1) any ERP mapping limitations (one PO per invoice id requirement), 2) whether we can embed multiple PO numbers in the invoice metadata so NorthWind can map them on their side, and 3) how early-invoices are treated from the revenue recognition perspective?

If it helps, we can produce a sample invoice (PDF) showing how we'd render two PO IDs + remit split. Would you like a sample? Happy to schedule a 30-min call if your AP team prefers.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0124

Attachment: Redwood_Billing_Integration_Guidelines.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO remit addresses + invoice cadence question

Vanessa — quick notes from Finance on constraints and a recommended pattern: 

1) Our billing ledger requires a single invoice identifier per generated invoice file. If NorthWind wants a single PDF, we can consolidate multiple PO line items into that PDF, but the invoice will have a primary invoice id on our side. We will, however, include all referenced PO numbers in the invoice header and in the machine-readable metadata (so ERP matching is possible).

2) For remit splits across entities, we can support AP distribution coding that specifies remit-to and BU mapping per line item. That means one invoice can credit multiple remit buckets, but some ERPs will still insist on one PO -> one invoice mapping — that is on NorthWind's side.

3) Net terms per entity: our system supports a single due date per invoice document. If you need different net terms by entity, we recommend issuing separate invoices (one per PO/entity). Alternatively, you can accept our consolidated invoice and we can apply a short-term credit memo workflow to mirror your internal net-term differences, but that adds reconciliation overhead.

4) Early/advance invoicing: Finance will issue an 'advance' invoice if prepayment is received; we can tag it as advance and apply it against future invoices. Revenue recognition (Markus please weigh in) needs the prepay invoice properly coded.

Action items: Vanessa to provide a sample consolidated invoice PDF layout. Vanessa/Grace to confirm whether the SOW requires separate PO scoping (Markus - legal/rev rec requirement?).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Billing_Integration_Guidelines.pdf (forwarded)
From: Tom Grady <tom.grady@northwind-health.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@northwind-health.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PO remit addresses + invoice cadence question

Vanessa / Ben / Grace — thanks for the clarity. Procurement and AP discussed and we're comfortable with the following approach: 

- NorthWind will issue two POs (one per legal entity). We'll include a cross-reference note in each PO pointing to the sibling PO number.
- Redwood can generate a single consolidated monthly statement PDF that includes line items grouped by PO number. We will accept the consolidated PDF as long as both PO numbers are included in the header and the machine-readable metadata (our ERP can parse the metadata and create separate AP obligations per entity).
- For net terms: NorthWind will accept your consolidated PDF approach and apply net terms on their ERP-side mapping (so one document, ERP splits per PO). If we run into exceptions, we'll fall back to one invoice per PO.
- Early invoice: we'll provide a prepayment for the first month; please issue an advance invoice so our treasury team can recognize the payment correctly.

Please confirm you can add both PO numbers to the invoice metadata and provide a sample PDF (with metadata visible) by EOD Monday. Attaching a sample PO for reference.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Tom Grady
VP, Procurement Operations
NorthWind Health
Attachment: sample_PO_NW-5567.pdf
